Steel is an alloy of iron.
Zinc is used to protect a steel car body from rusting. The steel body is completely coated in zinc.
Which statements about this use of zinc are correct?
1
The layer of zinc prevents oxygen reaching the steel to cause rust.
2
Zinc is used because it is a more reactive metal than iron.
3
If the zinc layer is scratched, the steel will rust.
A
1, 2 and 3
B
1 and 2 only
C
1 only
D
2 and 3 only
subject: Chemistry
